trainingCorpus.source: SpaceNet2 aligned RGB and 8-band WorldView3 multispectral imagery
trainingCorpus.library: USGS Spectral Library Version7; matched WorldView3-resampled and AVIRIS2014-convolved records
trainingCorpus.libraryFiltering: Complete matching material identifiers, reflectance values in [0,1.5], then factor2 uniform subsampling
trainingCorpus.synthesis: Fixed pretrained reconstruction generator predicts abundance logits and positive illumination; softmax simplex abundances and softplus illumination; transfer same coefficients through paired library. No paired measured HSI training cubes.
trainingCorpus.supervision: SAM3 pseudo-masks generated from aligned visible imagery, not manually verified HSI material labels
trainingCorpus.qualitativePlausibility: Shared PCA of800 synthetic/800 real HyperSeg AVIRIS spectra and independently normalized spectral envelopes; not a paired radiometric fidelity test

architecture.base: Original November2025 Meta SAM3 image release and facebook/sam3 sam3.pt as stated by manuscript; current upstream README also describes SAM3.1, not substituted
trainable: HSI side encoder initialized from RGB transformer where compatible
architecture.spectralViews: Two independently sampled contiguous128–224 band windows, interpolate each to224; redraw identical second view and require at least32 overlapping original bands
architecture.loss: Best candidate weighted BCE+Dice in each view, averaged across views; symmetric binary KL with entropy confidence; router balance
architecture.confidenceBoundary: Class-specific selection and shifting schedule described qualitatively; exact selection fractions, numerical schedule, l0, encoder width/depth, optimizer, batch size, training iterations/seeds not reproducibly specified in this read manuscript.
architecture.equationsAndFigureBoundary: Fig4 prints TV loss on HSI and RGB consistency on HSI, while Eq4 applies TV(a)+TV(illumination) and an8-band Pms projection term. Preserve both original wordings; implementation mapping unresolved. Eq16 common-confidence update read, not independently validated training code.

HC.support: One randomly seeded labeled pixel/class; pool50 configurations shared across compared methods; remaining labeled pixels test
HC.decision: Smallest mask covering support, mean dense features, single-pixel deterministic fallback; nearest cosine prototype. Random-initialized deep baselines trained with same label budget, LP variants frozen backbones plus linear probe.

HAD.decision: Automatic mask proposals; suppress large background regions and project retained compact proposals to anomaly response map.

HCD.decision: Independent masks/date, mean embeddings in same region at both dates, cosine distance; maximum of two directional response maps

HTD.support: Same prescribed target spectrum or support prompt for all methods; spectrum cosine match yields support point
HTD.calibrationBoundary: Thresholds fixed by named scene; choice provenance and target-label independence of threshold selection not verified.

HOSD.trainingSceneOverlapClaim: Not used in HyperSAM training, as stated in paper
HOSD.boundary: Labeled prototype evaluation; do not call zero-shot/no-label oil-spill inference.

mainResults.aggregation: Page15 explicitly calls TableII best testing results; not the50-configuration mean or full-fine-tuning SOTA. Selection rule/seed list unavailable.
negativeCases: Beach1 ODP1.4977 below SpectralEarth1.8992, HyperSIGMA1.8943 and DOFA1.8920; DF best does not mean both metrics best.
Cri TSTTD DF0.9999/ODP1.8754 above HyperSAM; HyperSIGMA ODP1.4957 also slightly above1.4951.
mainResults.metricBoundary: DF/ODP higher better as stated; ODP values above1 are kept, not clamped or converted to percentages. Exact detection-metric implementation unavailable.

ablationBoundary.tableIII: Full Airport ODP1.3297 below SynHSI withoutMoE1.3544 and withoutConfidence1.3587; do not say every component improves every metric.
ablationBoundary.tableIV: Zero initialization improves four printed metrics against random initialization in specified setting; code-level stability proof not verified.
ablationBoundary.tableV: Airport ODP full1.3297 below w/oProjection1.3312 and w/oTV1.3421.
ablationBoundary.tableVI: Airport ODP full1.3297 below w/oBCE1.3396, w/oConfidence1.3587 and w/oBalance1.3472; table has no w/oLcons row despite prose attributing consistency benefits.

costAudit.powerIntegration: Trapezoidal integration of total sampled GPU board power during entire benchmark command; idle power diagnostic not subtracted from table
costAudit.includes: Command init/model/data loading and full target-scene inference; baseline target-scene training/probing when required
costAudit.excludes: Upstream pretraining; CPU/RAM/storage/network and embodied hardware emissions
costAudit.independentArithmeticCheck: 0.624Wh /1000 *475=0.2964g, matches printed estimate; does not verify measured trace.
costAudit.accuracyBoundary: 66.91 OA cost replay statistics separate from main TableII best69.37.
costAudit.configurationBoundary: TableVII caption says three cold-start replays of same configuration; page15 prose says one selected support configuration from pool per repetition. Actual seed/configuration identities not given; retain ambiguity rather than assert distinct support sets or pooled50 mean.
costAudit.interpretation: Higher reported accuracy, not minimum energy or lifecycle carbon advantage.
